# Health Savings Accounts

A health savings account, or HSA, is available to people enrolled in a high-deductible health plan. Contributions are tax-deductible, growth is tax-free, and withdrawals for qualified medical expenses are also tax-free, which is often called a triple tax advantage.

## Investing inside an HSA

Many HSA providers let you invest the balance in funds once it passes a minimum. Some people pay current medical costs out of pocket and leave the HSA invested for the long term, treating it as an extra retirement account for future health costs.
